step1_analysis.description: A cross-coupled CMOS inverter pair that provides negative resistance to compensate for LC tank losses in a Voltage-Controlled Oscillator (VCO).

paper_reference.title: Influence of Novel MOS Varactors on the Performance of a Fully Integrated UMTS VCO in Standard 0.25-m CMOS Technology

sky130_expected.calculation: With an added ideal LC tank of L=2nH and C=2pF in the testbench, f = 1 / (2*pi*sqrt(LC)) = 2.51 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined primarily by the external LC tank added in the testbench to enable oscillation.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the oscillator core

sky130_expected.calculation: Self-bias voltage Vm where Idn = Idp is ~0.71V. I_dc = 2 * 0.5 * 270u * 10 * (0.71-0.42)^2 = 227uA. Power = 1.8V * 227uA = 0.41mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the transistor sizing (W=5u, L=0.5u) and supply voltage (1.8V). The paper's 7.5mW includes larger transistors and a 2.5V supply.

output_swing.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing at the output nodes

sky130_expected.calculation: CMOS cross-coupled pair typically swings rail-to-rail, so single-ended swing is ~1.8V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Limited by the supply voltage and transistor saturation.
Requires PSS/PNOISE analysis which is complex in standard ngspice.

tuning_range.description: Frequency tuning range as a percentage of center frequency

sky130_expected.reasoning: Cannot be measured without the varactor sub-circuit which is missing from this specific netlist.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure oscillation frequency, output swing, and power consumption of the VCO core with an added ideal LC tank.
step3_testbench.spice:
* VCO Core Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 Q QX VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 QX Q VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 Q QX VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 QX Q VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

* Power Supplies
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0

* Ideal LC Tank to enable oscillation
L1 Q QX 2n
C1 Q QX 2p
R1 Q QX 10k

* Initial condition to kickstart oscillation
.ic v(Q)=1.8 v(QX)=0

.control
  * Transient Analysis
  tran 10p 20n uic
  
  * Measure Oscillation Frequency
  meas tran t1 trig v(Q) val=0.9 rise=10 targ v(Q) val=0.9 rise=11
  let osc_freq = 1 / t1
  print osc_freq
  
  * Measure Amplitude
  meas tran vq_max max v(Q) from=10n to=20n
  meas tran vq_min min v(Q) from=10n to=20n
  let v_pp = vq_max - vq_min
  print v_pp
  
  * Measure Power Consumption
  meas tran i_vdd_avg avg i(VVDD) from=10n to=20n
  let power = -i_vdd_avg * 1.8
  print power
  
  quit
.endc
.end
